lineAr: نُشر من 2 نوفمبر إلى 8 نوفمبر 2026 ما مجموعه 3,327 ثغرة جديدة، منها 312 حرجة و1,233 عالية الخطورة، وأُضيف إلى قائمة الثغرات المستغلة فعلياً 3 ثغرات.
paragraphsAr: شكّلت الثغرات الحرجة والعالية ⁨46%⁩ من سجلات الأسبوع، بينما بقيت 234 ثغرة دون تقييم للخطورة حتى تاريخ النشرة.
وتصدّرت أنواعَ الضعف البرمجة النصية عبر المواقع (XSS) بعدد 289 ثم غياب التخويل بعدد 233.
وكان ⁨Google⁩ أكثر المورّدين وروداً في السجلات بعدد 354 يليه ⁨IBM⁩ بعدد 322.
وأدرجت CISA خلال الأسبوع 3 ثغرات في قائمتها للثغرات المستغلة فعلياً، لذا تُقدَّم معالجتها على غيرها.
وأعلى ثغرات الأسبوع احتمالاً للاستغلال بحسب نظام EPSS هي ⁨CVE-2026-77690⁩ باحتمال ⁨15.6%⁩ خلال الثلاثين يوماً المقبلة.

kevAdded.n: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
kevAdded.act: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kevAdded.d: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

epssTop.d: ZohoCorp ManageEngine Key Manager Plus versions before 7151 were vulnerable to a Command Injection vulnerability that allowed authenticated users with certificate deployment privileges to execute arbitrary commands through specially crafted input when configuring a deployment target.

epssTop.t: Irontec sngrep through 1.9.0 Out-of-Bounds Stack Read via sip_check_packet
epssTop.d: Irontec sngrep through 1.9.0 contains an out-of-bounds stack read vulnerability in sip_check_packet and sip_validate_packet caused by an off-by-one length check on 10240-byte SIP payloads. Remote attackers can send a crafted UDP or TCP SIP packet or supply a pcap file to crash sngrep or leak adjacent stack bytes into displayed SIP fields.

epssTop.t: Nagios XI < 2026R2 OS Command Injection via mibs.php
epssTop.d: Nagios XI before 2026R2 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the MIB upload feature where the install_mib() function in mibs.php sanitizes uploaded filenames with an incomplete character-substitution filter that omits semicolons, pipes, and non-space IFS whitespace characters before passing them to a grep command run via exec(). An authenticated administrator can upload a MIB file with a crafted filename using tab characters to bypass the deny-list and pipe to sh via a multipart POST request to mibs.php, resulting in arbitrary OS command execution as the web server user.

epssTop.t: SuiteCRM: Authenticated SSRF in CalendarAccount testConnection Allows Internal Network Access and Response Disclosure
epssTop.d: SuiteCRM is an open-source, enterprise-ready Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software application. Prior to 7.15.2 and 8.10.2, the CalendarAccount testConnection action passes an authenticated caller's server_url directly to curl without host, address, or scheme validation. The affected flow begins at CalendarAccount::action_testConnection and uses server_url, CalDAVProvider::makeCalDAVRequest(), and PROPFIND to carry attacker-controlled data or authorization state into the security-sensitive operation. The server sends a PROPFIND request from its network context and returns non-success response bodies, enabling internal-service access, partial response disclosure, service enumeration, and possible cloud metadata access. This issue is fixed in versions 7.15.2 and 8.10.2.

epssTop.t: Quest Foglight for Databases getSource XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability
epssTop.d: Quest Foglight for Databases getSource XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to initiate arbitrary server-side requests on affected installations of Quest Foglight for Databases. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getSource method. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the application. Was ZDI-CAN-29934.
